name: martino-grafica
description: Sitio web + API + panel de Martino Gráfica (Next.js 16 + NestJS 11 + PostgreSQL)

scripts.setup: npm run env && npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm -w apps/api run start:dev" "npm -w apps/web run dev"
scripts.build: npm -w apps/api run build && npm -w apps/web run build
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm -w apps/api run start:prod" "npm -w apps/web run start"
scripts.typecheck: npm -w apps/api run typecheck && npm -w apps/web run typecheck
